skills.name: Uniswap Get Quote
skills.description: Get a real-time price quote for a token swap on Uniswap V3 without executing any transaction. Supports both exact-input ('I have 0.1 ETH, how much USDC do I get?') and exact-output ('I want 100 USDC, how much ETH do I need?') modes. Automatically selects the best fee tier and returns human-readable amounts. Use this before Uniswap Build Transaction to confirm the price.

tokenIn.description: Input token symbol (e.g. 'ETH', 'USDC') or contract address

tokenOut.description: Output token symbol (e.g. 'USDC', 'WETH') or contract address

amountIn.description: Human-readable input amount, e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH. Do NOT use raw wei. Mutually exclusive with amountOut.

amountOut.description: Human-readable desired output amount (exact-output mode), e.g. '100' for 100 USDC. Mutually exclusive with amountIn.

feeTier.description: Pool fee tier (100=0.01%, 500=0.05%, 3000=0.3%, 10000=1%). Omit to auto-select the best tier.

amountIn.description: Human-readable input amount (filled in for exact-output queries)

priceImpact.description: Price impact as a percentage, e.g. 0.08 means 0.08%

route.description: Token symbols in the swap route, e.g. ['ETH', 'USDC']

executionPrice.description: Effective price: how many tokenOut per 1 tokenIn

gasEstimate.description: Estimated gas units as a string

usage_examples.title: Exact-input: sell 0.1 ETH for USDC on Optimism
usage_examples.description: How much USDC do I get for 0.1 ETH?

usage_examples.title: Exact-output: buy 100 USDC with ETH on Optimism
usage_examples.description: How much ETH do I need to get exactly 100 USDC?

skills.name: Uniswap Build Transaction
skills.description: Build an unsigned Uniswap V3 swap transaction (calldata only). Returns the raw transaction fields { to, data, value } that the caller signs and broadcasts using their own wallet or signing infrastructure (hardware wallet, MPC, AA). Does NOT hold or use any private keys. Supports exact-input and exact-output modes with human-readable amounts. Use Uniswap Get Quote first to confirm the price before building.

tokenIn.description: Input token symbol (e.g. 'ETH', 'USDC') or contract address

tokenOut.description: Output token symbol or contract address

amountIn.description: Human-readable input amount, e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH. Do NOT use raw wei. Mutually exclusive with amountOut.

amountOut.description: Human-readable desired output amount for exact-output swaps, e.g. '100' for 100 USDC. Mutually exclusive with amountIn.

recipient.description: Recipient wallet address (0x...) who will receive the output tokens

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%, 100 = 1%). Default: 50

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline. Default: now + 20 minutes

to.description: Swap Router contract address to send the transaction to

value.description: ETH value to send in hex wei (0x0 for ERC-20-only swaps)

amountIn.description: Human-readable input amount (useful for exact-output to show cost)

usage_examples.title: Exact-input: build calldata to sell 0.1 ETH for USDC on Optimism
usage_examples.description: Build unsigned tx to swap 0.1 ETH → USDC. Caller signs with their own wallet.

usage_examples.title: Exact-output: build calldata to buy exactly 100 USDC on Optimism
usage_examples.description: Build unsigned tx to receive exactly 100 USDC, spending at most ETH + 0.5% slippage.

skills.name: Uniswap Pool Info
skills.description: Retrieve comprehensive information about a Uniswap V3 liquidity pool including TVL, 24h volume, fees earned, current price, and liquidity depth. Supports all major EVM chains and fee tiers.

token0.description: First token symbol (e.g. 'USDC') or contract address

token1.description: Second token symbol (e.g. 'WETH') or contract address

apr.description: Estimated APR for LPs based on 24h fees

usage_examples.title: Get USDC/ETH pool info on Ethereum (0.05% tier)
usage_examples.description: Retrieve TVL, volume, and APR for the main USDC/ETH pool

skills.name: Uniswap Chain Config
skills.description: Query static configuration for Uniswap V3 on any supported chain: contract addresses (router, factory, quoter), well-known token addresses, supported fee tiers, and the list of supported chains. Use this to avoid hardcoding addresses in your agent and to validate chain support before calling other Uniswap skills.

chain.description: Chain to query. Omit to get a list of all supported chains.

supported_chains.description: All chains where Uniswap V3 is supported

chain.description: The queried chain (only present if chain was specified)

fee_tiers.description: Supported fee tiers in basis points: 100 (0.01%), 500 (0.05%), 3000 (0.3%), 10000 (1%)

tokens.description: Well-known token symbol → address mapping for this chain
